# Amara Nwosu

Amara Nwosu is the institute's archivist. She is based at [[tolvan-lab]] and
looks after the paper collections.

# Archive Move (2024)

In 2024 the paper logbooks moved from the old records room to the archive
vault at [[tolvan-lab]]. The move took three weeks.
# Asterwick Institute

The Asterwick Institute is an independent research institute that studies
coasts, moorland and the night sky. It runs six projects: [[project-heron]],
[[project-saltmarsh]], [[project-ember]], [[project-quill]],
[[project-lantern]] and [[project-wren]].

# Brask Station

Brask Station stands on Brask Point, near the village of Ostervik.

# Castellan Marine

Castellan Marine builds instruments for use at sea. It is based in Aberdeen,
Scotland.

# Drift Buoy DB-9

The Drift Buoy DB-9 is a floating buoy that logs water temperature, salinity
and wave height. It is made by [[castellan-marine]] and stored at
[[brask-station]] between deployments.

# Hana Sato

Hana Sato is a remote-sensing analyst. She is based at the
[[harrowgate-annex]].

# Harrowgate Annex

The Harrowgate Annex is the institute's upland outpost, on the moor above
the market town of Harrowgate.

# Instrument Registry

The instruments the institute owns:

- [[mirror-array-mx4]]: optical mirror array
- [[drift-buoy-db9]]: drifting sea buoy
- [[thermal-mast-tm2]]: thermal camera mast
- [[spectro-cart-sc7]]: portable spectrometer
- [[lidar-pod-lp3]]: airborne lidar pod
- [[scanner-rig-sr1]]: overhead document scanner
# Junia Ferraz

Junia Ferraz is an ecologist. She is based at [[kelmouth-site]] and
maintains the [[mirror-array-mx4]].

# Kelmouth Flood (March 2025)

In March 2025 a storm surge flooded the wet lab at [[kelmouth-site]]. Field
gear was moved to [[tolvan-lab]] for six weeks while the floor was rebuilt.
# Kelmouth Site

Kelmouth Site is the institute's field station on the estuary, near the
harbour town of Penhallow.

# Lidar Pod LP-3

The Lidar Pod LP-3 is an airborne laser scanner that hangs under a light
aircraft and measures ground height to a few centimetres. It is made by
[[velloria-optics]] and stored at [[brask-station]].

# Lucia Moreau

Lucia Moreau is a field technician. She is based at [[kelmouth-site]] and
maintains the [[spectro-cart-sc7]].

# Maren Solberg

Maren Solberg is an instrument scientist. She is based at [[brask-station]]
and maintains the [[drift-buoy-db9]].

# Mirror Array MX-4

The Mirror Array MX-4 is a tripod-mounted array of angled mirrors and a
camera that counts birds on a colony without disturbing them. It is made by
[[velloria-optics]] and stored at [[kelmouth-site]].

# Oskar Lindqvist

Oskar Lindqvist is a fire scientist. He is based at the [[harrowgate-annex]]
and maintains the [[thermal-mast-tm2]].

# Pemberton Scanning

Pemberton Scanning supplies scanning and spectroscopy hardware. It is based
in Leeds, England.

# Pieter van Dam

Pieter van Dam is an optical engineer. He is based at [[brask-station]] and
maintains the [[lidar-pod-lp3]].

# Project Ember

Project Ember aims to detect moorland wildfires within minutes, by spotting
heat and smoke before a fire spreads.

# Project Heron

Project Heron monitors the nesting colonies of herons, egrets and other
wading birds along the estuary. Counts run every week from April to August,
and the colony maps go to the regional bird trust.

# Project Lantern

Project Lantern maps light pollution over the coast at night and tracks how
dark the sky stays for migrating birds.

# Project Quill

Project Quill is digitizing the institute's handwritten field logbooks from
1950 to 1990, so that old weather and tide notes can be searched.

# Project Saltmarsh

Project Saltmarsh surveys how fast the salt marshes on the north shore are
eroding, and how the tidal channels move from year to year.

# Project Wren

Project Wren measures soil moisture on upland farms, to help farmers plan
grazing through dry summers.

# Scanner Rig SR-1

The Scanner Rig SR-1 is an overhead camera rig with a glass book cradle, for
photographing bound pages. It is made by [[pemberton-scanning]] and stored
at [[tolvan-lab]].

# Spectro Cart SC-7

The Spectro Cart SC-7 is a portable spectrometer on a wheeled cart, for
reading soil and plant samples in the field. It is made by
[[pemberton-scanning]] and stored at [[kelmouth-site]].

# Staff Directory

The research staff of the institute:

- [[maren-solberg]], instrument scientist
- [[teodor-halim]], data engineer
- [[junia-ferraz]], ecologist
- [[oskar-lindqvist]], fire scientist
- [[amara-nwosu]], archivist
- [[pieter-vandam]], optical engineer
- [[lucia-moreau]], field technician
- [[hana-sato]], remote-sensing analyst
# Teodor Halim

Teodor Halim is a data engineer. He is based at [[tolvan-lab]] and maintains
the [[scanner-rig-sr1]].

# Thermal Firmware Recall (January 2026)

In January 2026 [[velloria-optics]] recalled firmware version 3.2 for its
thermal cameras, after it misread temperatures in frost. The
[[thermal-mast-tm2]] was rolled back to version 3.1.
# Thermal Mast TM-2

The Thermal Mast TM-2 is a ten-metre mast with a thermal camera that watches
the moor for hot spots. It is made by [[velloria-optics]] and stored at the
[[harrowgate-annex]].

# Tolvan Lab

Tolvan Lab is the institute's main laboratory, in the city of Tolvan.

# Velloria Optics

Velloria Optics makes lenses, cameras and laser sensors. It is based in
Turin, Italy.

## Calibration

During the fire season the camera is calibrated every two weeks; in winter,
once a month.
## Calibration

The array is calibrated every six weeks against a printed target board.
## Calibration

The buoy's sensors are calibrated every three months in a reference tank.
## Calibration

The pod is calibrated before every flight campaign, and at least every ten
flights.
## Calibration

The rig's colour and focus are calibrated once a year.
## Calibration

The spectrometer is calibrated once a month with a white reference tile.
## Facilities

It has a boat dock, a wet lab and a drying room for field gear.
## Facilities

It has a weather mast, a drone hangar and a fire-watch room.
## Facilities

It has an archive vault for paper records, a server room and the main
chemistry lab.
## Facilities

It has an instrument workshop, a clean room and a small hangar for the
survey aircraft.
## Organisation

The institute works from four sites: [[kelmouth-site]], [[brask-station]],
[[tolvan-lab]] and the [[harrowgate-annex]]. Everyone who works here is
listed in the [[staff-directory]], and every instrument is listed in the
[[instrument-registry]].
## Team and equipment

The project is led by [[amara-nwosu]] and runs from [[tolvan-lab]]. Pages
are captured with the [[scanner-rig-sr1]].
## Team and equipment

The project is led by [[hana-sato]] and runs from [[tolvan-lab]]. Detection
relies on the [[thermal-mast-tm2]].
## Team and equipment

The project is led by [[maren-solberg]]. Fieldwork runs from
[[kelmouth-site]], and the colonies are counted with the
[[mirror-array-mx4]].
## Team and equipment

The project is led by [[oskar-lindqvist]] and runs from [[brask-station]].
Night flights carry the [[lidar-pod-lp3]].
## Team and equipment

The project is led by [[pieter-vandam]] and runs from [[kelmouth-site]].
Elevation surveys use the [[lidar-pod-lp3]], and water readings come from
the [[drift-buoy-db9]].
## Team and equipment

The project is led by [[teodor-halim]] and runs from the
[[harrowgate-annex]]. Soil samples are read with the [[spectro-cart-sc7]].
## Warranty and support

Its instruments carry a two-year warranty. Support is by email only, with a
reply within two working days.
## Warranty and support

Its warranty lasts eighteen months. It runs a 24-hour support phone line.
## Warranty and support

Its warranty lasts three years and includes on-site repair within five
working days.
